symptoms: Rosetted flowers ('rosette' appearance due to petals webbed together), boreholes plugged with excreta on developing bolls, damaged seeds, stained lint, premature boll dropping.
economic_threshold_level_etl: 8 moths/trap/night for 3 consecutive nights OR 10% infested green bolls with larvae.
integrated_pest_management_ipm: Install pheromone traps with Gossyplure @ 2 per acre for monitoring, 8-10 per acre for mass trapping.
Release Trichogramma bactrae egg parasitoid @ 60,000 per acre (3 releases at weekly intervals from 45 DAS).
Spray Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE 5%) or Azadirachtin 1500 ppm @ 5 ml/litre at early square formation.
If ETL is breached: Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC @ 0.3 ml/L or Emamectin Benzoate 5 SG @ 0.5 g/L or Profenofos 50 EC @ 2 ml/L.
cultural_precautions: Avoid extending the cotton crop into ratoon or multi-season picking. Shred cotton stalks immediately after harvest to destroy diapausing larvae.

pest_disease: Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (ToLCV) & Whitefly vector (Bemisia tabaci)
symptoms: Severe curling, cupping, and puckering of leaves, vein clearing, stunted bushy plant growth, dropping of floral buds, almost zero fruit setting.
vector_transmission: Transmitted by whitefly (Bemisia tabaci). The virus cannot be cured once inside the plant; management relies on vector control and resistant varieties.
integrated_pest_management_ipm: Grow virus-resistant / tolerant hybrids (e.g. Arka Rakshak, Arka Samrat, US-440).
Erect 20-25 yellow sticky traps per acre to capture adult whiteflies.
Raise nursery inside 40-mesh insect-proof nylon net houses.
Spray 5% NSKE or Neem oil (3 ml/L) as prophylactic deterrent.
Chemical vector control: Drench nursery with Imidacloprid 17.8 SL @ 0.3 ml/L. In field, spray Diafenthiuron 50 WP @ 1 g/L or Spiromesifen 22.9 SC @ 1.25 ml/L on undersides of leaves.
cultural_precautions: Rogue out and destroy infected plants immediately upon early symptom appearance to prevent field spread.

pest_disease: Early Blight & Late Blight (Alternaria solani & Phytophthora infestans)
symptoms: Early blight: Concentric target-board rings on older leaves, yellow halo, defoliation. Late blight: Water-soaked irregular dark lesions on leaves and green fruits, white fungal growth on undersides during cool humid weather.
integrated_pest_management_ipm: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 5g/kg or Captan @ 2g/kg.
Prophylactic spray of Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5 g/L or Copper Oxychloride @ 3 g/L.
Upon first appearance: Spray Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole @ 1 ml/L or Cymoxanil + Mancozeb @ 2 g/L (for late blight) or Tebuconazole @ 1 ml/L (for early blight).

pest_disease: Stem Rot / Root Rot (Macrophomina phaseolina) and Jute Semilooper
symptoms: Stem rot: Brownish black lesions on stem near ground level or nodal points; shredded fibrous vascular tissues with tiny black sclerotia. Semilooper: Caterpillar cuts apical shoots and defoliates young leaves.
integrated_pest_management_ipm: Correct acidic soil pH by applying agricultural lime (calcium carbonate) @ 2-4 q/ha.
Seed treatment with Carbendazim 50 WP @ 2 g/kg seed.
For Semilooper: Spray Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) @ 1.5 g/L or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC @ 0.3 ml/L.
For Stem Rot: Foliar spray of Carbendazim 12% + Mancozeb 63% WP @ 2 g/L upon symptom detection.

symptoms: Yellow Rust: Bright yellow powdery stripes of urediniospores arranged linearly along leaf veins; easily stains fingers yellow. Aphids: Clustered sucking insects on ears and flag leaves secreting honeydew.
integrated_pest_management_ipm: Sow rust-resistant varieties (HD-3086, DBW-187, DBW-222, PBW-725).
Avoid excess early Nitrogen fertilizer which favors lush vegetative rust susceptibility.
On rust notice: Immediately spray Tebuconazole 25.9 EC @ 1 ml/L or Propiconazole 25 EC (Tilt) @ 1 ml/L (500 ml in 500 L water per ha).
For Aphids: Conserve ladybird beetles; if population exceeds 5 aphids per earhead, spray Thiamethoxam 25 WG @ 0.2 g/L.
